WHAT DISTINGUISHES
The Shoolin Group Hospitality Experience
The Shoolin Experience is a celebration of heritage and unparalleled hospitality. Every moment with us is crafted to provide a seamless blend of traditional elegance end modern comfort, whether you're staying at one of our grand palaces, relaxing at our serene resorts, or attending an unforgettable event.
Our properties reflect the rich cultural heritage of coastal Karnataka, offering guests an authentic yet elevated experience. From personalized service to exquisite dining and thoughtfully designed spaces, The Shoolin Experience promises to leave you with memories of exceptional warmth, style and grace.

THE SHOOLIN GROUP
Shoolin Palace
Shoolin Palace is a majestic resort in Maravoor, Mangalore, designed to host luxury events like weddings, parties and celebrations. Featuring a stage above a stunning pool, a soundproof party hall with world-class acoustics, and flexible event hours, we ensure an unforgettable experience. Along with its breathtaking venues, Shoolin Palace offers 15 elegantly designed rooms in a hotel, providing guests with both comfort and convenience. Located 5 minutes from the airport, it offers seamless accessibility, making it the perfect destination for celebrations. Experience sophisticated grandeur and impeccable hospitality at Shoolin Palace.

THE SHOOLIN GROUP
Hotel Shoolin Grand
Situated in the heart of Mangalore, Hotel Shoolin Grand is a refined urban hotel offering a seamless blend of comfort and convenience. Located close to the railway station and major city landmarks, our hotel is designed for both business and leisure travelers. With modern, well-appointed rooms, exceptional service, and easy accessibility, we provide a stay that balances elegance and efficiency. Whether you're here for work or a relaxing getaway, Hotel Shoolin Grand ensures a premium experience with top-tier hospitality.

THE SHOOLIN GROUP
Shoolin Resorts
Nestled in the serene surroundings of Manipal, Shoolin Resorts is a tranquil escape for those seeking seeking premium experience relaxation & natures beauty. The property caters to travelers looking for both leisure and indulgence. With its lovely setting and unparalleled hospitality, Shoolin Resorts is the perfect destination for family vacations, business retreats, and intimate gatherings.

THE SHOOLIN GROUP
Shoolin Comforts
Strategically located at Kavoor Junction between the airport and city, Hotel Shoolin Comforts is designed for effortless stays with a perfect balance of accessibility and warmth. Featuring Deluxe and Superior rooms, modern amenities, and easy access to key areas, it is the ideal choice for both short and long stays. Whether you're a business traveler or a tourist, our commitment to personalized service and thoughtful hospitality ensures a comfortable and memorable stay away from the hustle bustle of the city.

SERVICES
Redefining Luxury
At The Shoolin Group, we blend sophisticated elegance with modern hospitality, offering a seamless experience of comfort, grandeur and impeccable service. Whether it's a premium stay or a grand event, we take pride in curating unforgettable moments with our exquisite venues, premium accommodations and personalized attention to detail. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every guest enjoys a refined yet welcoming atmosphere where elegance feels effortless.
DESIGN ELEMENTS
Creative Motivations
At The Shoolin Group, design is more than aesthetics — it's the overall value proposition. Our properties aims to offer the best of both comfort and luxury ensuring that every space feels both inviting and refined. From the interiors to furnishings to thoughtfully curated lighting and décor, every detail is crafted to enhance style and practicality. Whether it's our hotel rooms, event venues, or lounge spaces, we create environments that are both appealing and welcoming.
ACCOMODATIONS
Step into a World of Timeless Comfort
At The Shoolin Group, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide an exceptional experience of elegance and ease. From the moment you arrive, you're welcomed into an atmosphere of refined hospitality, where traditional charm blends seamlessly with modern convenience.
